title: Transition Elements: Definition, Exceptions & Characteristics
subtitle: Definition, Group 12 Exception, Cu/Ag/Au & 8 General Properties

definition.heading: Precise Definition of Transition Elements
definition.p1: Transition elements are defined as elements whose atoms possess partially filled d-subshells either in their ground state (elementary state) or in any of their common oxidation states.
definition.p2: All d-block elements whose d-orbitals are not completely filled are termed transition elements.
definition.p3: In the periodic table, they are situated right between the s-block and p-block. They act as a transition between highly electropositive s-block metals and electronegative p-block non-metals.

exceptions.heading: Exception: Group 12 Elements (Zn, Cd, Hg, Cn)
exceptions.p1: Elements of Group 12 like Zinc (Zn), Cadmium (Cd), Mercury (Hg), and Copernicium (Cn/Uub) are members of the d-block, but are NOT considered true transition elements.
exceptions.reason: Because in both their elemental ground state and their common oxidation states (+2), their d-orbitals are completely filled (d¹⁰). They lack partially filled d-orbitals, which is why they are not classified as true transition elements.

group11.heading: Group 11 Elements: Cu, Ag, Au
group11.p1: In Group 11 elements Cu, Ag, Au, the d-orbitals are fully filled in atomic ground state (d¹⁰ s¹), but in their common oxidation states such as Cu²⁺ (3d⁹), Ag²⁺ (4d⁹) and Au³⁺ (5d⁸), the d-orbitals are partially filled. Therefore, they are classified as transition elements.

typical.heading: Non-typical vs Typical Transition Elements
typical.p1: Elements of Group 3 [Sc, Y, La, Ac] differ in properties from other transition elements: their compounds are trivalent, diamagnetic, and colourless. In contrast, other transition elements exhibit variable oxidation states, coloured ions, and paramagnetism.
typical.p2: Elements of Group 3 [Sc, Y, La, Ac] and Group 12 [Zn, Cd, Hg, Uub] are called non-typical (अविशेष) transition elements. These are 8 elements.
typical.p3: Other transition elements are called typical (विशेष) transition elements. These are 32 elements.

properties.heading: 8 General Properties of Transition Elements
list: All these elements are metals and good conductors of heat and electricity.
They possess high melting and boiling points.
